questions.q: A to H are persons compared according to their age and the speed at which they finish a certain job. A is older than B and faster than C. D is younger than E, older than H, and slower than F. G is older than H, younger than C, slower than H, and faster than F. H is older than A and slower than C. Based on the preceding statements, which of the following is true?
options: A is the second oldest and the third fastest.
G is older than E and slower than A.
C is younger than D and faster than H.
D is the eldest and slowest.
H is older than B and slower than D.
questions.answer: C is younger than D and faster than H.

questions.q: Points E, F, G, I are arranged in a line in such a way that F is between G and I, and E is between F and I. If E precedes G, in what order are they arranged?
options: E F G I
E I G F
F I G E
I E F G
I G F E

questions.q: In a certain examination, 300 competitors passed the first part and 500 passed the second part. The number of competitors who passed both parts of the examination will most likely be __________.
options: between 500 and 600
between 400 and 500
between 300 and 400
not more than 300

questions.q: Anna, Karen and Nina take turns in getting the midnight shift at Ward 143 such that no one is assigned two nights in a row. Anna was assigned two nights ago and is assigned again tomorrow evening. If Karen is assigned the night immediately following Anna's duty, who can take tonight's midnight shift?
options: Only Anna
Only Karen
Only Nina
Either Anna or Karen
Either Anna or Nina

questions.q: Mina, Bing, Amy, and Cel have surnames Flores, Mendez, Perez, and Reyes, but not respectively. Mina is taller than Amy and Cel. Ms. Mendez is tallest of the four. Ms. Flores is taller than Ms. Reyes but shorter than Ms. Perez. Also, Cel is taller than Amy and Bing. What is the full name of the second tallest person?
options: Amy Mendez
Cel Perez
Cel Flores
Bing Reyes
Mina Perez

questions.q:
Determine the best assumption that can be logically made from the given statement:

Gigi is probably a pianist. She can really stretch her hands and fingers.
options: Only people with big hands and long fingers can be pianists.
Playing the piano helps Gigi stretch her hands and fingers.
Stretching helps pianists perform better.
A long stretch enables pianists to reach more keys on the piano.
Pianists can really stretch their hands and fingers.
questions.answer: Pianists can really stretch their hands and fingers.

questions.q:
Determine the best assumption that can be logically made from the given statement:

Arlene should not be part of the basketball team because she does not trust her teammates.
options: The basketball team needs Arlene even if she has no faith in them.
Teammates should have faith in each other.
Arlene's teammates are not trustworthy.
Arlene's teammates do not have faith in the team.
Arlene is better than her teammates.
questions.answer: Teammates should have faith in each other.

questions.q:
Determine the best assumption that can be logically made from the given statement:

If you are so smart, then why aren't you rich?
options: To become rich is difficult
Only the rich are smart
Only the smart are rich
All rich people are smart
All smart people are rich

questions.q:
Determine the best assumption that can be logically made from the given statement:

In order to improve our admission process and get better students, we have decided to include an interview of the applicants as a criterion.
options: Current admission procedures are greatly inadequate
Current admission criteria need to be updated
An interview of the applicants will help draw better students
An interview of the applicants will be too time consuming
An interview of the applicants will ensure the students' success in school
questions.answer: An interview of the applicants will help draw better students

questions.q:
Determine the best assumption that can be logically made from the given statement:

The present administration helps poor people acquire basic necessities for living; that is why it helps squatter dwellers like Aling Rosie.
options: The present administration hates rich people
Aling Rosie asked the present administration to help her
Squatter dwellers pretended to be poor
Squatter dwellers compete with poor people for the present administration's attention
Squatter dwellers are considered poor people
questions.answer: Squatter dwellers are considered poor people

questions.q:
Determine the best conclusion that can be logically made from the given statements:

Artists are never ham-handed. All artists are inquisitive. Peter is not ham-handed. Florence is not inquisitive.
options: Peter is an artist
Peter is not an artist
Florence is not an artist
Inquisitive people are not ham-handed

questions.q:
Determine the best conclusion that can be logically made from the given statements:

Subscribing to Cable T.V. is a luxury. All luxuries are needless expenditures. Having a cellular phone is not a luxury. Dining in a Five-Star hotel is a needless expenditure.
options: Having a cellular phone is not a needless expenditure
Subscribing to Cable TV is a needless expenditure
Subscribing to cable TV is not a needless expenditure
Dining in a Five-Star hotel is not a luxury
Dining in a Five-Star hotel is a luxury
questions.answer: Subscribing to Cable TV is a needless expenditure

questions.q:
Determine the best conclusion that can be logically made from the given statements:

Some managers are not analytical. All managers are ruthless. Vicente is ruthless.
options: Vicente is a manager but is not analytical
Vicente is analytical but is not a manager
Some ruthless managers are not analytical
Not all analytical managers are ruthless
All ruthless people are analytical
questions.answer: Some ruthless managers are not analytical

questions.q:
Determine the best conclusion that can be logically made from the given statements:

All of my friends believe in marriage. Geraldine is a new friend. She lives with an officemate in an apartment downtown.
options: Her housemate is most likely a good friend
She is living-in with her boyfriend
She needs a companion in the city
Geraldine believes in marriage
Geraldine is not married yet

questions.q:
Determine the best conclusion that can be logically made from the given statements:

There are fewer juvenile delinquents in communities where the youth participate actively in different socio-civic and religious clubs. Barangay X has a number of youth clubs.
options: Barangay X has fewer juvenile delinquents than other barangays
Parents in Barangay X exert great efforts to prevent juvenile delinquency
Municipal officials encourage the organization of youth clubs
Community development workers in Barangay X give training in organizing youth clubs
All young people in Barangay X are members of at least two youth clubs.
questions.answer: Barangay X has fewer juvenile delinquents than other barangays
